jobs.occupation: Business development manager DACH region - fixed contract
jobs.description:
Searching for a job in sales?Want to work in a company who's values are doing the right thing, doing waht is best for the customer and driven in improvements and innovations?The company is Belgium based, but are you willing to travel extensively within the DACH region?

This internationaly active production company is looking for a business development manager who will be responsible for driving sales growth, developing new business opportunities across the German-speaking market (Dach region: Germany, Austria and Switzerland). You will play a pivotal role in expanding the company’s footprint, strengthening relationships with distributors in various markets.

• You will identify and pursue new business opportunities within the DACH region.
• Relationships with distributors and resellers will you build and maintain.
• For accounts in this region, you will serve as the primary point of contact.
• You will develop tailored solutions and proposals to meet specific customer needs.
• The market trends and competitor activities will you analyze to identify growth opportunities.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
• At least 5 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, or account management, preferably in the industrial or manufacturing sectors.
• Fluent in German and English (written and spoken).
• Strong understanding of the DACH market and cultural nuances.
• Proven ability to develop and maintain client relationships.
• Excellent negotiation and presentation skills.
• Analytical mindset with the ability to use data to drive decision-making.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office suite and CRM tools.

DHL Aviation, DHL Express’s sorting center in Belgium, is the beating heart of package transport at the airport.The brand-new building is a showcase of automation and technology in the field of logistics. Shipments are delivered by truck or plane from all over the world, consolidated at Brucargo, and sorted for their final destinations. These shipments are then loaded onto trucks or planes again and transported to their final destinations.

Jobomschrijving

As a warehouse worker for DHL Aviation, you are trained to perform following tasks: loading and sorting of incoming and outgoing shipments by trucks and plains throughout the world. DHL has an excellent on-the-job training so you don’t need to have any relevant work experience: enthusiasm and willingness to learn are far more important.

• Your knowledge of English is very good (important for all work and safety related instructions on the job).
•  You have a basic knowledge of Dutch (level A1, your level will be put to the test).
• You can work full-time, 38hours a week.
• You can work from Monday through Friday on a weekly base in the shifts 7PM-3AM and 8PM-4AM.
• You are willing to improve your knowledge of Dutch (DHL offers Dutch learning sessions during the working hours).
• DHL Aviation is located on the following address: Vliegveld 117, 1820 Steenokkerzeel.
• You are able to get to work on your behalf
• You are looking forward to having an energetic job that requires you to walk a lot and lift heavy shipments ( /- 25 kg on a regular basis)
• Working safely comes first for you.
• You can work in accordance with internal quality processes and procedures, as well as legal requirements.

Our team is responsible for performing the final quality checks on Honda motorcycles. Every employee receives comprehensive internal training to prepare them for the role.Your tasks will include: 

 
• Connecting motorcycle batteries 
 
• Checking and refilling engine oil 
 
• Inspecting motorcycles for scratches or damage 
 
• Performing general quality checks on assembly and finishing 

Who are we looking for? 

 
• Experience in assembly or production 
 
• A background in construction or technical work 
 
• Recent graduates from technical programs 
 
• Anyone with technical affinity and the motivation to learn 
 
• Work schedule: 2 shifts (06:00–14:00 & 14:00–22:00) 
 
• English communication skills are required.

You start your day with a full truck and drive to supermarkets and distribution points. Every trip brings new places and regular customers. You work according to a fixed daily schedule.You are the company's calling card.Our client is a reliable player in frozen food logistics. They combine a modern fleet with a professional approach and attach great importance to safety and punctuality.- You deliver frozen goods to supermarkets and distribution centers- You deliver to multiple locations per day and ensure correct unloading- You manage delivery documents accurately- You communicate smoothly with planners and customers when necessary- You respect driving and rest times and always drive safely

Are you looking for an active night shift job in a cold (-22°C) and stable working environment?Then this might be your new challenge!You will be working for a rapidly growing logistics company that distributes frozen products.As an Order Picker, you are an indispensable link in the logistics process. You ensure that orders are prepared and shipped without errors.- You collect frozen products using a pick list and scanner.- You stack boxes correctly on pallets according to the instructions.- You prepare orders for shipment and place pallets in the correct location.- You work with an electric pallet truck.- You strictly follow safety and quality rules.
- Vaardigheden:You have experience as an order picker or logistics employee.You are familiar with working with an electric pallet truck.You can work without any problems in a frozen environment of -22°C.You enjoy active work.You work accurately, are reliable, and think in terms of the team.- Attesten:Certificate for electric pallet truck is a plus, but not mandatory.- Opleidingsvereisten:No diploma required.- Talenkennis:Good knowledge of English

📦 Warehouse Worker in 2 Shifts Wanted – Do you enjoy active work in a dynamic environment?
 

Are you someone who likes to roll up their sleeves and enjoys an active job? For a growing logistics company in the frozen food sector, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers who want to work in a well-organised warehouse.
 

Your tasks:
 

 
• Picking products using voice picking or a scanner
 
• Preparing orders for transport
 
• Loading and unloading trucks
 
• Working with an electric pallet truck and/or reach truck 

Who are we looking for?
 

 
• You have experience as a warehouse worker or are motivated to learn
 
• You have experience with an electric pallet truck
 
• You work safely
 
• You speak Dutch or English
 
• You are willing to work in a freezer environment

jobs.occupation: Chauffeur CE with a valid Code 95
jobs.description:
What will you do?
 

As a CE driver, you are the company’s representative on the road. Your tasks include:
 

 
• Transporting chilled and frozen food products
 
• Loading and unloading goods (with an electric pallet truck)
 
• Correctly completing transport and delivery documents
 
• Checking cargo, temperature, and vehicle condition
 
• Complying with driving and rest time regulations, traffic laws, and safety rules
 
• Maintaining customer-friendly contact during deliveries
 
• Keeping your truck clean and tidy 

Your profile
 

 
• You have a valid CE driving licence
 
• Your Code 95 is up to date
 
• Experience with refrigerated transport is a plus
 
• You drive safely, responsibly, and defensively
 
• You can work independently but are also a team player
 
• You speak and understand Dutch or English
 
• You have a professional and customer-oriented attitude

❄️ Order Picker Wanted – Stable Job in the Frozen Food Sector (Oostkamp)
 

Are you someone who likes to stay active and get things done? Do you work accurately and doesn’t a cold environment scare you? Then this is the perfect job for you! For a stable and international logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated order pickers.
 

📦 What will you do?
 

Make sure orders are shipped correctly and on time
 

 
• Order picking using voice picking or a scanner
 
• Checking products (quality and quantities)
 
• Preparing orders for shipment
 
• Working with an electric pallet truck
 
• Working in a freezer environment (-22°C) 

💪 Who are we looking for?
 

Experience as an order picker is a plus, but not required
 

 
• You are physically fit and enjoy active work
 
• You work accurately and follow instructions correctly
 
• You speak Dutch or English
 
• You are motivated and looking for a stable job

Our customer was established in 1968 and is a part of a big Automotive Corporation in Japan. The Brussels office is the headquarters of 8 branches in France, Germany, Poland, Czech, Turkey, Italy and Hungary. They are urgently looking for a Business Developer E-Mobility Supply Chain. With experience in Purchase, in automotive sector. This position involves real trading activities and business transactions with partners across Asia (including Japan). They are looking for a dynamic Business Developer who can accelerate this process, drive growth, and coordinate projects effectively.
 

Key Responsibilities:
 

 
• Business Development & Supply Chain
 
• Build and strengthen relationships with Asian automotive suppliers.
 
• Manage commercial activities, customer communication, logistics, and cost calculations.
 
• Identify and onboard new manufacturing partners.
 
• Support procurement activities, including supplier evaluation, negotiations, and QCD (Quality, Cost, Delivery) management.
 
• Electrification & Market Development
 
• Develop new business opportunities for battery-related materials and EV components.
 
• Conduct market research and identify emerging technologies and innovative companies.
 
• Explore strategic partnerships and investment opportunities.
 
• Strategy & Market Intelligence
 
• Monitor market and competitor developments.
 
• Support business growth strategies and market-entry initiatives.
 
• Collaborate with international teams to align regional and global objectives. 

Your Profile:
 

 
• Bachelor's degree (Master's is a plus).
 
• Fluent in English.
 
• Experience in procurement, purchasing, sales, or business development; previous experience within the company is a strong asset.
 
• Familiarity with Genchi Genbutsu and Kaizen principles is a plus.
 
• Technical or engineering background preferred, or a strong interest in business development.
 
• Strong communication and negotiation skills in an international environment.
 
• Proficient in MS Office and other business software.
 
• Your Competencies
 
• Customer-oriented, positive, and proactive mindset.
 
• Strong analytical and business acumen.
 
• Able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
 
• Fast learner with a growth mindset.
 
• Flexible and comfortable working across cultures.
 
• Team player who takes ownership and follows tasks through to completion.

Looking for a varied role in the logistics sector?Would you like to join an international working environment?Then SD Worx Jobs has the perfect opportunity for you! 

For a growing logistics company in the Willebroek region, SD Worx Jobs is looking for a Warehouse Operator.

Your responsibilitiesµ

No two days are the same! As a key player in the logistics process, you help ensure that operations run smoothly and efficiently.

• Receive incoming goods and place them in the correct warehouse locations.

• Pick and pack online orders for shipment.

• Perform quality checks to ensure high service standards.

• Monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner.

• You speak and understand English.

• Previous experience in logistics is preferred.

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for logistics employees for the Bleckmann warehouses in Rieme and Desteldonk (near Ghent) to support the Black Friday sale from 16 November until 4 December. You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year, you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters for the Rieme warehouse

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Dampoort for the Desteldonk warehouse

• Departure at 5u10 

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

Are you a proven Sales professional or an experienced Recruiter looking for your next challenge?Or you have a strong sales mindset and looking for your first job?At Oliver James, we're looking for ambitious 360° Recruitment Consultants to grow our Belgian IT market.This is not a traditional HR role. You will build your own market, develop new business, headhunt top IT talent and manage the recruitment process from A to Z.The Role

• Build and develop your own Belgian market
• Prospect and win new clients to build your portfolio
• Develop long-term relationships with decision-makers
• Head-hunt, interview and advise IT professionals
• Manage the recruitment process from A to Z
• Negotiate with clients and candidates
• Own your targets, pipeline and results
• Become an expert in your market

Who are we looking for?Experienced Recruiters who want more commercial ownership, earning potential and career progression.Sales Professionals with a strong background in B2B sales, business development or account management who want to build a career in recruitment.In both cases, you are: 

• Ambitious, competitive and commercially driven
• Comfortable with targets and prospecting
• A strong communicator and negotiator
• Fluent in French OR Dutch + English
• Holding a Bachelor's or Master's degree
We care more about your ability to build relationships, win business and deliver results than your job title.

Do you also love the idea of working in chocolate? Then this opportunity is definitely for you! We are looking for production workers who can help out during the upcoming chocolate season. What will you be doing?
 

 
• Packing pralines, seashell chocolates, chocolate bars, etc. into boxes
 
• Labeling finished products and pallets
 
• Tying ribbons around praline boxes
 
• Applying stickers to finished products
 
• Wrapping boxes in foil
 
• Carrying out quality control checks 

Who are you?
 

 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5 a.m.–1 p.m. / 1 p.m.–9 p.m.) or possibly a fixed night shift (9 p.m.–5 a.m.)
 
• You have a good knowledge of the Dutch or English language
 
• You have your own mode of transport
 
• You are flexible regarding working hours
 
• You are willing to work in the food industry

What do you have to do?
 

 
• As a production line operator, you set up the machine according to the correct parameters and make adjustments as needed.
 
• You inspect the quality of the finished products.
 
• You supply raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.
 
• Your responsibilities will also include changing machine setups, as well as cleaning and maintaining the production line. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You are willing to work in the food industry
 
• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards
 
• You have your own transportation
 
• You have a good to very good knowledge of Dutch or English
 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5am-1pm and 1pm-9pm)
 
• You are willing to complete in-house training
 
• You have a truly hands-on attitude
 
• You are a team player
